verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Stripe Issuing cards can be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Samsung Pay. That is an adjacent wallet-provisioning feature. Nothing documents network token objects, listing tokens per card, identifying the wallet or merchant that holds a token, or revoking tokens separately from the PAN.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN
